curriculum.title: Grade 1
curriculum.description: Ontario Grade 1 mathematics for YRDSB learners, with concrete models, varied questions, and guided exploration. Activities support practice, not certification of mastery.

suggestedSequence: Build whole-number quantities, comparison, and part-whole reasoning.
Connect concrete models, stories, equal relationships, and patterns.
Apply counting to spatial reasoning, units, and daily routines.
Collect, sort, display, and compare observations and likelihood.
Read or combine Canadian values and make grade-appropriate choices.
Revisit coding, modelling, communication, and learning habits. This is an app suggestion, not a published YRDSB timetable.
